goal.request: Improve the reverse-image-prompt skill using the current OpenAI latest-model guidance, then independently extract prompts and generate text-only reconstructions for three historical source images.

evidence.claim: The v3 candidate suite passes 311 tests and 267 subtests. Module, manifest, compiled coverage and skill-format checks pass; final binding checks validate all three exact prompts, plans and bundles.

Entrypoint body words decrease 3492 to 1146. In the fixed five-lane fixture shared instruction body words decrease 5311 to 3988 for prompt and 4081 for audited. These are structural words, not tokenizer counts or elapsed time.
All three real audited case routes fail under the v1 validator and pass under v2 with unchanged visual instruction bytes and route fingerprints.
Three exact historical user inputs were restored and inspected; source-specific review invariants were recorded before any generated pixels were available.
Selection records identify original historical user-message images, dimensions and exact source hashes; prior extracted prompts and renders were withheld from case agents.

The current latest-model guide supports auditing contradictory skill instructions, explicit delegation policy and calibrated verification. Analysis harness settings are distinct from image generator settings.

The unchanged case-01 plan fails solely on a contradictory coupling of displayed-skin priority to whole-person salience under v2 and passes under v3. Existing requirements declare these priorities independently; region and descriptor checks remain enforced.
All 113 pinned files match in the working skill and each of the three v3 copies; exact source bytes, critic plan/prompt hashes, saved request bodies and all nine frozen bundle/plan/lint checks match.

All three historical cases completed audited extraction, exact-text standalone checks and a source-aware critic before generation. This is per-case conformance evidence, not a baseline comparison or proof of pixel fidelity.

Two delivered images were inspected against source contracts frozen before generation. Both preserve broad scenes but materially drift in capture, displayed surface, shape or pose; both are partial reproductions and overall fidelity failures.

Case-03 produced no delivered image: initial failure cause is unavailable, then an identical-byte retry was rejected at output moderation. Pixels and user judgment remain unscored; no substitution or bypass was attempted.
Case-01 delivered once in one call; case-02 delivered once after one identical-byte no-delivery retry. No quality retries were made and image-reference fields were omitted.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Select only the requested analysis contract while preserving all shared visible-evidence controls; keep prompt conformance, actual generation, visual fidelity and user judgment separately evidenced.

invariants.statement: Explicit profile selection changes the instruction view without heuristically dropping shared rules.
Each text-only reconstruction is assessed against its exact historical source for composition, appearance geometry, topology, light, color and capture rather than a generic attractive replacement.
causal_controls: case-specific source contracts stored outside runtime
no image references supplied to generation

flexible_dimensions: Unexposed runtime settings recorded as unavailable, never invented

mismatches.source_state: Real routes declare audited analysis and bind audited report schemas and instruction views.
mismatches.render_state: Before the fix the bundle validator reconstructs the default prompt route and rejects the real audited route; generation had not yet occurred.

mismatches.source_state: Displayed skin and whole-person appearance have independently supported priorities in the existing evaluation contract.
mismatches.render_state: The v2 validator rejected a valid P1 skin decision for a primary person before generation; v3 removes only that contradictory equality.

mismatches.source_state: Historical sources include low contrast, soft boundaries, specific garment drape and source-specific subject proportions/pose.
mismatches.render_state: The two delivered images strengthen fine detail or material articulation; case-01 changes head/earcup share and case-02 weakens the body diagonal and thickens knit.

hypotheses.statement: Explicit selected-profile views and a smaller entrypoint reduce irrelevant instruction text while preserving shared constraints. This may reduce instruction conflicts; runtime speed and fidelity require separate empirical evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shared required rules disappear from a selected view, or unrelated sections are removed by heuristic filtering.

hypotheses.statement: Reconstructing a route with its declared profile resolves the deterministic rejection without relaxing exact equality or allowing evidence to be rebound by profile tampering.
hypotheses.falsifier: A valid audited route still fails, or changing only the profile can reuse a mismatched route/report fingerprint.

hypotheses.statement: Removing the incompatible whole-person equality permits independently evidenced skin salience while retaining all region, descriptor, ownership and identity guards.
hypotheses.falsifier: A missing skin region, wrong descriptor ownership, or an unsupported identity claim becomes valid after the change.

intervention.general_rule: Separate execution profiles with explicit views, preserve source/view hashes and complete-input failures, keep salience ordering authoritative across adapters, validate optional aggregate claims at their data boundary, expose a plan-free standalone prompt check, and reconstruct audited routes with their declared profile. Preserve the independently evidenced priority of displayed skin rather than equating it to whole-person salience.
intervention.generalization_basis: Changes apply to file/profile boundaries, schema fields and route integrity; none installs one historical image, appearance term, garment, pose, color or composition as a runtime default.

prompt.scope: Conformance of these three extracted prompts; no comparative prompt-quality claim.

render.scope: Both delivered historical replays have material drift. The third has no pixels and remains blocked/unscored, not a perceptual failure.

limitations: Three historically seen human-image regressions, no new holdout or nonhuman coverage.
No baseline re-generation arm; no comparative fidelity or elapsed-time improvement is established.
Fresh case coordinator contexts and separate case directories share one OS. Available fresh lane workers were 1/2/1; remaining lanes used declared same-context fallback after capacity limits.
Root critic and pixel reviewer are common across cases, independent of case integrator transcripts but not blind or newly empty contexts.
Case-03 accidentally saw sibling status summaries from a collaboration inventory; no sibling artifacts or previous prompts/renders were opened or used.
The v1/v2/v3 visual instruction bytes are identical. v2/v3 repair deterministic validators; failed original snapshots and outcomes are retained.
Observed case spans include audited ledger authoring, waiting, provider recovery and reporting. Exact backend model, tool size/quality controls and some worker timings were not exposed.
Formal calibrated color/light and user aesthetic judgments remain unscored.

decision.rationale: Structural changes and regression fixes are implemented and validated. Three genuine historical forward replays were attempted with frozen text-only requests: two deliveries both exhibit material fidelity drift, and one output is blocked. No comparative speed, render fidelity or user-aesthetic promotion is claimed.
